scenarios.title: Auto voice — English short
scenarios.description: Neither reference audio nor style instruct. Model picks a voice. Language is explicitly English.
scenarios.text: OmniVoice creates clear speech from text with minimal setup.
scenarios.listen_for: Natural English voice, clear phrasing, no clone of ref.wav.

scenarios.title: Auto voice — Chinese short
scenarios.description: Auto voice with Chinese language tag.
scenarios.text: 欢迎使用 OmniVoice。这是一段中文自动音色的试听样本。
scenarios.listen_for: Chinese auto voice, not English clone.

scenarios.title: Auto voice — language-agnostic
scenarios.text: This sample leaves language unspecified so the model chooses freely.
scenarios.listen_for: Should still be intelligible English-ish speech without explicit lang.

scenarios.title: Voice design — British female
scenarios.description: Style control via instruct text only (no reference audio).
scenarios.text: Good afternoon. This reference should sound calm, precise, and suitable for a polished product demo.
scenarios.listen_for: Female British accent, calm product-demo tone.

scenarios.title: Voice design — male American high pitch
scenarios.description: Different instruct attributes using only OmniVoice-supported English tags (see voice-design docs).
scenarios.text: Hey there! Ready to ship another release? Let's make this one count.
scenarios.instruct: male, high pitch, young adult, american accent
scenarios.listen_for: Clearly different from 04 — younger male American voice.

scenarios.title: Voice design — Chinese + nonverbal tag
scenarios.description: Chinese text with [laughter] control tag. Instruct uses full-width Chinese attribute list.
scenarios.text: [laughter]今天的发布会到此结束，感谢大家的聆听，祝你晚上愉快。
scenarios.listen_for: Brief laughter then Chinese closing line.

scenarios.title: Voice clone — ref audio + ref text
scenarios.description: Classic zero-shot clone: provide ref.wav and its transcript. Target text is different from the reference transcript.
scenarios.text: This cloned sample should preserve the speaking style from the provided reference audio.
scenarios.listen_for: Should match speaker/style of ref.wav (ref text: “State-of-the-art text-to-speech model for 600+ languages, supporting…”).

scenarios.title: Voice clone — ref audio only (ASR transcript)
scenarios.description: Clone with ref_audio but without ref_text. OmniVoice ASR auto-transcribes the reference clip.
scenarios.text: Automatic transcription of the reference should still allow a solid clone.
scenarios.listen_for: Same speaker as 07 if ASR succeeds; may fail if ASR deps missing.

scenarios.title: Long-form chunked — English
scenarios.description: Long text forces chunked generation (audio_chunk_threshold / duration). Checks stitching and pacing across chunks.
scenarios.text: OmniVoice can synthesize long-form speech while keeping memory usage stable. In this listening check, the text is intentionally longer than a typical demo sentence so the pipeline is forced through its chunking path. Each section should stay intelligible, maintain similar pacing, and join smoothly with the following section. We repeat the core idea so the model has enough text to split. OmniVoice can synthesize long-form speech while keeping memory usage stable.
scenarios.listen_for: Long continuous speech, smooth joins, no harsh cuts between chunks.

scenarios.title: Control — slow speed (0.85×)
scenarios.text: This sentence should be spoken more slowly than the default auto sample.

scenarios.title: Control — fast speed (1.2×)
scenarios.text: This sentence should be spoken faster than the default auto sample.

scenarios.title: Control — fixed duration (4.5 s)
scenarios.description: duration=4.5 forces approximate output length (overrides speed).
scenarios.text: Please stretch or compress this line to about four and a half seconds.
scenarios.listen_for: Clip length near 4.5s (check WAV duration in player).

scenarios.title: Control — numeric text (no external TN)
scenarios.description: Speaks a line with digits without WeTextProcessing (normalize_text=False). Shows default number reading.
scenarios.text: Please call me at 2345 on March 15, 2026 about invoice 99.
scenarios.listen_for: How digits/dates are spoken without optional text-normalization deps.

scenarios.title: Voice design — whisper
scenarios.description: Instruct uses only supported tags: female + whisper.
scenarios.text: Keep this confidential. We will announce the launch next week.

scenarios.title: Voice clone — create_voice_clone_prompt reuse
scenarios.description: Builds VoiceClonePrompt once via create_voice_clone_prompt, then generates with voice_clone_prompt=... (API reuse path).
scenarios.text: Reusing a cached clone prompt should sound consistent with direct clone.
